title: Concept: Editor swap file served by the app
description: A vim swap file reachable from the host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The swap file holds the unsaved buffer, which can be newer than the served file and still contain the credentials that were removed before saving.
applicability: Deployments that render a vim swap file reachable from the host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The swap file holds the unsaved buffer, which can be newer than the served file and still contain the credentials that were removed before saving.
